Elaine (Marketing): Heads-up — I put together a draft GTM playbook for the Q3 product push (Dedicated beta + PLG experiments). Sharing link: https://redwood.co/drive/gtm-q3-draft :eyes:
Samir (Sales): Thanks — skimmed. Quick ask: what's the published launch window? our AE team needs a firm date to block capacity for demos.
Elaine (Marketing): Targeting July 22 for limited beta announcement, full ramp Aug 12. Flexible if engineering pushes.
Nina (Product): July 22 is tight given rollout policy and canary. Need clear launch criteria: SLOs, rollback plan, and acceptance metrics.
Ben (Growth): For PLG we should run a dual-experiment: (A) onboarding checklist nudges, (B) usage-based free tier bump. Hypothesis: A improves activation, B increases MQLs.
Maria (Enablement): I'll need final UI screenshots, a demo script, and 2-hour playbook workshop slot for AEs before July 22. Can we commit to that?
Samir (Sales): Workshop pls — also can we add a short FAQ about failure modes and fallback models for enterprise buyers. They ask it every time.
Nina (Product): Agree on FAQ. For launch criteria propose: 1) 95th pctl latency under SLA for 99% traffic; 2) E2E smoke tests passing across regions; 3) no P0 regressions in last 72h; 4) agreed fallback model documented.
Elaine (Marketing): That works. I'm adding those to the doc as "must-have" launch criteria. Also want micro-goals for PLG conversion to include in the campaign brief.
Ben (Growth): Proposed OKRs snippet (quick):
```
Objective: Increase Q3 paid conversions via Dedicated + PLG
KR1: +30% paid convert rate from PLG cohorts
KR2: 1,500 demo requests generated by marketing campaigns
KR3: 20 enterprise stakeholders engaged end-of-quarter
```
Ben (Growth): We should A/B test copy in the signup flow and report weekly.
Samir (Sales): Sales target ask: set ARR target for beta cohort — propose $320k in committed ARR from pilot accounts as a stretch. Thoughts?
Nina (Product): Stretch seems aggressive but useful for planning. We should also define acceptance criteria for pilot accounts (SLA needs, data residency). I'll add the pilot account checklist.
Maria (Enablement): For the playbook I'll draft: 30-min pitch, 15-min demo flow, 10 common objections + one-pagers. Will post by next Tue.
Elaine (Marketing): PLG experiments — Ben can you pick 2 cohorts and a success metric per cohort by EOD Tuesday? We'll wire CTR -> activation -> paid funnel tracking.
Ben (Growth): On it. My preliminary cohorts: 1) small dev teams (<5 seats) via free tier, 2) startups joining via marketplace integration. Success metrics: activation at day 3, paid conversion by day 30.
Nina (Product): Dev note: we need analytics events for onboarding steps and a way to flag experiment users server-side. @deploy-bot can we get a quick deploy window for the flags?
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window opened: 2024-07-05 02:00 UTC — 2hr maintenance. Use feature-flagged rollout.
Samir (Sales): Great. One more ask: enablement needs a short playbook slide deck + one-pager cheat sheet for AEs and SDRs. Elaine — can marketing own the deck?
Elaine (Marketing): Yes — we'll own the deck. Maria, I'll pair with you on content this week.
Maria (Enablement): Perfect. Also requesting a short product changelog template so AEs can forward release notes to customers.
Nina (Product): I'll add a changelog stub in the repo and tag PRs for the beta.
Ben (Growth): For measurement: weekly dashboard with signups, activation, paid conversions, demo requests, and SQL velocity. Who will own?
Elaine (Marketing): Marketing owns demos + top-of-funnel tracking. Product owns telemetry and feature flags. Growth owns experiments and dashboard composition. We'll share a single sheet.
Samir (Sales): If we hit pilot ARR target early, can we expand early access? Might be a good conversion lever.
Nina (Product): Potential but only if deployment capacity is OK. We'll add a conditional clause to rollout policy.
Elaine (Marketing): Action items recap: Ben — cohorts + metrics by Tue; Maria — playbook draft by Tue; Nina — pilot checklist + changelog stub; Samir — confirm top 6 pilot targets; Elaine — finalize campaign brief and landing pages.
Ben (Growth): I'll post cohort details in the doc tonight.
Samir (Sales): I'll confirm pilot targets with AMs today.
Maria (Enablement): Workshop slot request: Thurs July 18 14:00 PT — can people pencil that in?
Elaine (Marketing): Added event to calendar.
Ben (Growth): Quick flag: we should consider an in-app tooltip experiment to reduce time-to-first-success. Small dev effort but high impact.
Nina (Product): Add a ticket to the backlog (label: q3-gtm).
Elaine (Marketing): Thanks all — I'll update the drive doc and ping when the playbook draft is ready. :rocket:
